summary: A short narrative: the same calls work on a laptop path, an S3-compatible bucket, an SFTP server or an HTTP endpoint; switching providers is a profile change; a location policy limits where code may reach; private stores are reachable through an SSH bastion.

concepts.name: Reach private stores through a bastion

documentation_plan: Hero demo: one script copying local -> S3-compatible -> SFTP with gzip in flight (proof: examples/cross_backend_copy, conformance tests).
Only claim backends that exist: local, S3/R2/MinIO/B2/S3 Express, SFTP, HTTP. GCS/Azure/FTP/SMB/GitHub are profiles only.
Tunnel callout must state the HTTPS-through-tunnel limitation and needs an example before promotion.
open_questions: Is there a runnable tunnel example to back the bastion claim?
